title: Daily 5, Wed 18 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: At simple interest, a sum becomes three times itself in 10 years. What is the rate per annum?
A does one third of a job in 5 days. At that rate, how many days does the whole job take?
A price falls from ₹800 to ₹680. Find the percentage decrease.
In what ratio (16% solution : 40% solution) must a 16% salt solution and a 40% salt solution be mixed to get a 25% solution?
